description: Canonical UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, no whitespace or floats. Source max 65536 bytes, chain max 262144 bytes, JSON depth 16. Custom formats sha256, hex64, commit and leaf are enforced by both readers. Clock integers are nanoseconds, due is 16:30 Asia/Seoul. Root/kernel/Docker trusted; SQL never attests scheduler origin.
title: Root source observations; decoding never grants authority
